package.name: easyfleet_navigation_manager
package.description: Fleet-wide navigation manager. Publishes one shared map on /global_map and one shared, live-editable (RViz interactive markers) route set on /global_routes, so every robot's own EasyNav instance can be pointed at the same data (by remapping its "incoming_map"/"incoming_routes" topics) instead of each robot loading its own local copy. Broadcasts one static, identity /tf_static transform from "map" to each watched robot's own "<robot_id>/map" frame, tying the two together. Also continuously watches every robot's planned navigation path and pauses/resumes robots (over EasyNav's GoalManager control protocol) on imminent path conflicts. Ships one executable, navigation_manager_node.
